mapper.select: SELECT latest.log_id AS log_id, latest.instance_id, i.title AS activity_title, latest.game_id, latest.room_id, latest.room_code, MAX(l.create_time) AS create_time, COUNT(l.log_id) AS log_count, 1 AS member_count, latest.user_id, latest.student_name, latest.student_no, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(l.room_status ORDER BY l.log_id DESC), ',', 1) AS room_status FROM ( SELECT current_log.* FROM gkzh_sszctop_room_log current_log INNER JOIN ( SELECT instance_id, user_id, MAX(log_id) AS latest_log_id FROM gkzh_sszctop_room_log WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND room_code = #{roomCode} AND (student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) GROUP BY instance_id, user_id ) latest_id ON latest_id.latest_log_id = current_log.log_id ) latest INNER JOIN gkzh_activity_week_instance i ON i.instance_id = latest.instance_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_sszctop_room_log l ON l.room_id = latest.room_id i.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{activityName}, '%') GROUP BY latest.log_id, latest.instance_id, i.title, latest.game_id, latest.room_id, latest.room_code, latest.user_id, latest.student_name, latest.student_no ORDER BY latest.log_id DESC
SELECT l.* FROM gkzh_sszctop_room_log l WHERE l.room_id = #{roomId} AND l.event_type NOT IN ('order.updated', 'member.ready', 'member.unready') ORDER BY l.log_id ASC
